message: Thank you. Your question was sent to an extension officer for review. You will get the answer here.

This advice comes from guides for Northern Ghana and may not suit Adaklu, so check this advice with your local extension agent. Consult your local AEA for advice on the recommended fall army worm control pesticide in your area (APNI). You should check your maize field at least once a week. Look for unusual patterns like insect damage, larvae, or eggs on leaves, cobs, or stems, and abnormal leaf color or stunted growth. To reduce future infestations, rotate maize with non-host plants like groundnut, deep plough and bury or burn infested maize residues, and keep the field well-weeded.
